name: The My Bookmarks page, as admin (who may make the clip; viewer has no download permission): the My Bookmarks page on its fallback route. The capabilities offer the page; the admin's page-probe bookmarks of an earlier run are deleted, then the webcheck makes its own through the API: one on every video it can see (movies and episodes, up to 30), more on the first two movies so there are over 50 (names, notes, unnamed ones, ranges) and one Fast clip of a short range. 'Library tools' links My Bookmarks (#/jfbm-bookmarks) above User; the page renders grouped (the count line, one group per video with the poster of a video the viewer can open, Open title, its rows by position), the sort list of each view, Flat (one history entry, no kit render, 50 rows and Load more, which appends and counts the page in the hash in place), Title A-Z kept across the views, Most bookmarks reset to the flat default, Recently created and Position in title against the API's order, the type, the four filters (Not in library against availability=Missing: the probe seeds a detached bookmark by holding a movie folder out of the sandbox media; alone, the webcheck accepts none) and the search (one history entry) with counts equal to the API's, a hard reload of a deep link, Back and Forward, See all from a video's page (item=) and Show every video, Open title and Back (the group marked and scrolled to, group= dropped from the hash in place), the shell endpoint and an unknown key; the bookmarks are deleted at the end. Run by bookmarks-page-probe.mjs in the default, bare and baseurl sandboxes.

steps.name: the Bookmarks script ran
steps.waitFor: !!window.__jfkit && !!window.__jfkit.jfbm && !!window.ApiClient && !!ApiClient.getCurrentUserId()

steps.name: the capabilities offer the page (Pages.Bookmarks true) and My Clips
the admin's page-probe bookmarks of an earlier run deleted, with their clips (the probe's own 'page-probe detached' seed is left to the probe)
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'page-probe', limit: 200 })); const ids = r.Items.filter(b => (/^page-probe/.test(b.Name || '') || /^page-probe/.test(b.Note || '')) && b.Name !== 'page-probe detached').map(b => b.Id); if (ids.length) await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: ids, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return ids.length;

steps.name: the videos the viewer can see: movies and episodes, up to 30
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie,Episode', Recursive: true, Limit: 30, SortBy: 'SortName', EnableImages: false }); return r.Items.map(i => ({ id: i.Id, name: i.Name, type: i.Type }));

steps.name: at least four videos, among them a movie and an episode
seed: one bookmark per video, then names, notes, unnamed ones and ranges on the first two movies until there are 56, and a 0:01-0:03 range for a clip
steps.script: const post = (body) => ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); const made = []; const T = 10000000; for (const v of __vars.videos) { made.push((await post({ ItemId: v.id, StartTicks: 5 * T, Name: 'page-probe ' + v.name.slice(0, 40) })).Id); } const movies = __vars.videos.filter(v => v.type === 'Movie'); let k = 0; while (made.length < 56) { const m = movies[k % 2]; const kind = k % 4; const body = { ItemId: m.id, StartTicks: (10 + k) * T }; if (kind === 0) body.Name = 'page-probe extra ' + k; else if (kind === 1) { body.Note = 'page-probe note ' + k; } else if (kind === 2) { body.EndTicks = (12 + k) * T; body.Name = 'page-probe range ' + k; } else { body.EndTicks = (11 + k) * T; body.Note = 'page-probe unnamed range ' + k; } made.push((await post(body)).Id); k++; } const clip = await post({ ItemId: movies[0].id, StartTicks: 1 * T, EndTicks: 3 * T, Name: 'page-probe clipped' }); made.push(clip.Id); return { ids: made, clipId: clip.Id, movieId: movies[0].id, movieName: movies[0].name };

steps.name: a Fast clip of the short range, through the API, completed
steps.script: await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.seed.clipId + '/Clip'), data: JSON.stringify({ Mode: 'Fast' }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) { const b = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.seed.clipId)); if (b.Clip && b.Clip.Status === 'Completed' && b.Clip.FileName) return b.Clip.FileName; if (b.Clip && b.Clip.Status === 'Failed') throw new Error('the clip failed: ' + b.Clip.Error); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); } throw new Error('the clip did not complete');

steps.name: what the API counts: all, episodes, ranges, clips, unnamed, 'page-probe extra', the groups, the detached
steps.script: const q = (p) => ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', Object.assign({ limit: 1 }, p))).then(r => r.TotalRecordCount); const g = (p) => ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Groups', Object.assign({ limit: 1 }, p))).then(r => r.TotalRecordCount); return { all: await q({}), titles: await g({}), episodes: await q({ itemTypes: 'Episode' }), ranges: await q({ hasRange: true }), clips: await q({ hasClip: true }), unnamedRanges: await q({ hasRange: true, named: false }), extra: await q({ searchTerm: 'page-probe extra' }), extraMovieNamedRanges: await q({ searchTerm: 'page-probe', itemTypes: 'Movie', hasRange: true, named: true }), missing: await q({ availability: 'Missing' }) };

the resource timings cleared and widened (the seeds and jellyfin-web's own requests can fill the browser's buffer of 250, so a poster request went unrecorded), the clock before the page
steps.script: performance.setResourceTimingBufferSize(5000); performance.clearResourceTimings(); return performance.now();

steps.name: as expected

steps.name: in the API's order for sortBy=CreatedAt, each created no later than the one before it
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { sortBy: 'CreatedAt', limit: 50 })); const ids = r.Items.map(i => i.Id); const times = r.Items.map(i => Date.parse(i.CreatedAt)); return { same: JSON.stringify(ids) === JSON.stringify(__vars.byCreated), ordered: times.every((t, i) => i === 0 || times[i - 1] >= t), rows: ids.length, first: times[0], last: times[times.length - 1] };

steps.name: in the API's order for sortBy=Position; within a title the positions don't decrease, in the API's items and on the rows
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { sortBy: 'Position', limit: 50 })); const ids = r.Items.map(i => i.Id); const seconds = (t) => t.split(' ')[0].split(':').reduce((a, p) => a * 60 + Number(p), 0); const rows = __vars.byPosition; return { same: JSON.stringify(ids) === JSON.stringify(rows.map(x => x.id)), ordered: r.Items.every((b, i) => i === 0 || r.Items[i - 1].ItemId !== b.ItemId || r.Items[i - 1].StartTicks <= b.StartTicks), rowsOrdered: rows.every((x, i) => i === 0 || rows[i - 1].item !== x.item || seconds(rows[i - 1].time) <= seconds(x.time)), titles: new Set(rows.map(x => x.item)).size };

steps.waitFor: location.hash === '#/jfbm-bookmarks?view=flat&q=page-probe&type=Movie&sort=Name&range=1'

steps.name: after the reload: the toolbar and the list as the hash says
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-mounted][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r || location.hash !== '#/jfbm-bookmarks?view=flat&q=page-probe&type=Movie&sort=Name&range=1') return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-row')) return false; return { view: r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-view][aria-pressed="true"]').getAttribute('data-jfbm-view'), type: r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-type][aria-pressed="true"]').getAttribute('data-jfbm-type'), sort: r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-sort').value, q: r.querySelector('input[type="search"]').value, range: r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-filter="range"]').checked, button: r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-filters-button').textContent, count: r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-count').textContent, title: (document.querySelector('.skinHeader .pageTitle') || { textContent: '' }).textContent.trim() }; })()

steps.name: the count equals the API's for the same filters
steps.assert: ((n) => __vars.reloaded.count.startsWith(n + ' bookmark'))((await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'page-probe', itemTypes: 'Movie', hasRange: true, limit: 1 }))).TotalRecordCount)

steps.name: grouped with the rest kept (Name A-Z is flat-only, so the grouped default)
steps.waitFor: location.hash === '#/jfbm-bookmarks?q=page-probe&type=Movie&range=1' && !document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] .jfbm-page-content').hasAttribute('aria-busy')

steps.name: Back
steps.script: history.back(); return true;

steps.name: the flat state again, rendered by the kit from the hash (one render)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); if (!r || location.hash !== '#/jfbm-bookmarks?view=flat&q=page-probe&type=Movie&sort=Name&range=1' || r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content').hasAttribute('aria-busy') || !r.querySelector('.jfbm-row')) return false; return { view: r.querySelector('[data-jfbm-view][aria-pressed="true"]').getAttribute('data-jfbm-view'), sort: r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-sort').value, renders: __jfkit.jfbm.instance.pages.state().renders.bookmarks }; })()

steps.name: Forward
steps.script: history.forward(); return true;

steps.name: grouped again
steps.waitFor: location.hash === '#/jfbm-bookmarks?q=page-probe&type=Movie&range=1' && document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] [data-jfbm-view][aria-pressed="true"]').getAttribute('data-jfbm-view') === 'grouped' && !document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] .jfbm-page-content').hasAttribute('aria-busy')

steps.name: 'My bookmarks (n)' with See all
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); const a = s && s.querySelector('.jfbm-section-links a[data-jfbm-link="bookmarks"]'); if (!a || a.getClientRects().length === 0) return false; return { text: a.textContent.trim(), href: a.getAttribute('href') }; })()

steps.name: See all links the page filtered to this video
one group, this movie's, with Show every video
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r || location.hash !== '#/jfbm-bookmarks?item=' + __vars.seed.movieId) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-group')) return false; return { groups: c.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-group').length, id: c.querySelector('.jfbm-group').getAttribute('data-jfbm-group'), count: r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-count').textContent, link: (r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-all-videos') || { textContent: '' }).textContent }; })()

steps.name: as expected (the count line's text ends with the link's)
steps.assert: __vars.seeAllPage.groups === 1 && __vars.seeAllPage.id === __vars.seed.movieId.replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase() && /on 1 title Show every video$/.test(__vars.seeAllPage.count) && __vars.seeAllPage.link === 'Show every video'

steps.name: every video again
steps.waitFor: location.hash === '#/jfbm-bookmarks' && document.querySelectorAll('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] .jfbm-group').length > 1

steps.name: Open title on the second group
the video's page
steps.waitFor: location.hash.startsWith('#/details?id=' + __vars.secondGroup) && !!document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide)')

steps.name: Back
steps.script: history.back(); return true;

steps.name: back on the page: that group marked and scrolled to, group= dropped from the hash in place (one landing)
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); if (!r || location.hash !== '#/jfbm-bookmarks') return false; const g = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-highlight'); if (!g || g.getAttribute('data-jfbm-group') !== __vars.secondGroup) return false; const b = g.getBoundingClientRect(); return { history: history.length, top: Math.round(b.top), bottom: Math.round(b.bottom), height: innerHeight }; })()

steps.name: the entry replaced, not pushed (Open title pushed one); the group in view
the shell endpoint: 200 text/html with the page marker; an unknown key 404
steps.script: const h = { Authorization: 'MediaBrowser Token="' + ApiClient.accessToken() + '"' }; const a = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Pages/bookmarks'), { headers: h }); const t = await a.text(); const b = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Pages/nope'), { headers: h }); return { status: a.status, type: a.headers.get('content-type'), marker: t.includes('data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"'), unknown: b.status };

steps.name: clean-up: the seeded bookmarks deleted with their clip
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: __vars.seed.ids, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return { deleted: r.Deleted.length, tombstoned: r.Tombstoned.length, notFound: r.NotFound.length, inUse: r.InUse.length, failed: r.Failed.length };
